Use only the supplied problem. Do not browse, access files, or execute code.

The following is a description of a funny cartoon for the New Yorker Caption Contest

  Description: A man is playing chess with the Grim Reaper. The man is smiling and appears to be making a move.

  Which of the following captions is the funniest?
(A) Looks like we both lose.
(B) Checkmate is actually the biggest gambit you could make right now.
(C) Okay, I captured one of your men so you have to take off an article of clothing.
(D) Democracy’s last move.
(E) Death says, "Be Not Proud."
(F) That’s called a ‘bingo’ which means I win and you have to take my mother-in-law!
(G) I'm going to live forever!
(H) Leonard soon learns what it means to win the battle and lose the war.
(I) What d'ya say we raise the stakes?
(J) Ha! It's not over until I take my hand off the piece! I'm immortal!


Solve the problem. End your answer with FINAL_ANSWER: followed by the answer in the format requested by the problem. Do not put commentary after the final answer.
